tradeDoctrineComputability.question: Is the 1-Plat Undercut computable from public data?
tradeDoctrineComputability.answer: PARTIALLY — computable for 6 of 17 probed items, and only against a coarse average row, never against a live order book.
tradeDoctrineComputability.fieldSemanticsCaveat: The API does not document what today_vol / yesterday_vol / custom_avg mean. /wfinfo/prices states its shape depends on an externally configured source. CG must not treat custom_avg as a live asking price without Drew confirming what it represents.
tradeDoctrineComputability.doctrineConsequence: Split engine: prime items have a coarse public average to reason from; mods, packs and the liquidating stock have NO public price at all and must move on trade credits with Drew-supplied numbers. Never treat the average as a live order.
